headline: Apple announces new iPhone
body: Apple Inc. today unveiled its latest iPhone model. The company said the new device features improved cameras and longer battery life. Analysts expect strong sales.

headline: Google invests in renewable energy
body: Google parent Alphabet announced a major investment in solar energy farms. The initiative aims to power all data centers with carbon-free energy by 2030.
